evidence.title: Design Spells UI UX Interaction Gallery Showcase

name: Design Spells UI UX Interaction Gallery Showcase
summary: Abduzeedo post presenting Design Spells, a gallery of micro-interactions and subtle UI/UX details from web apps.
description: An August 2026 post by jeff on Abduzeedo that showcases Design Spells, a curated library of micro-interactions and subtle interface details. It highlights precise button hover effects, smooth state swaps and tactile haptic cues, framing small UI details as lessons for app and web teams, with entries open for submission ("Get featured").
